The AI-Powered Platform for OT and IoT Visibility & Security
Purpose-built for complex industrial, commercial and critical infrastructure environments, the Nozomi Networks platform combines visibility from the endpoint to the air with continuous monitoring and AI-powered analysis. We help you minimize cyber risk, maximize operational resilience, and streamline compliance with the toughest standards and regulations.
Request a demo
How we use AI
But OT environments are different:
They prioritize safety and availability over confidentiality
They use unique, often insecure, communication protocols unknown to IT tools
They rely on heterogenous vendors and device types
They can never be patched or updated on demand
From day one, Nozomi Networks has been deeply rooted in addressing the unique requirements of critical infrastructure and industrial companies.

Nozomi Networks Platform Features
AI-Powered Cybersecurity
Refined in-house for more than a decade, our AI engine uses a variety of techniques to enrich asset profiles, baseline normal behavior, raise issues and provide actionable insights into your environment that explain what to do now.
Learn More
Asset Inventory & Visibility
Using a combination of sensors, passive and active data collection, OT/IoT protocol support and third-party IT asset data, the platform provides a complete asset inventory — turbocharged with actionable, AI-powered asset intelligence.
Learn More
Risk Management
The platform continuously identifies, assesses, mitigates and monitors risk in your environment. It helps operators and SOC teams collaborate to prioritize efforts and take the most impactful actions to reduce risk and increase resilience.
Learn More
Threat & Anomaly Detection
The platform continuously baselines and profiles every device and its behavior to pinpoint network and endpoint security threats and process anomalies that need attention, informed by curated OT and IoT threat intelligence to stay on top of emerging threats.
Learn More
Vulnerability Management
The platform continuously identifies, scores and prioritizes high-risk vulnerabilities in your OT and IoT devices, with clear dashboards that drill down for deeper troubleshooting and remediation help.
Learn More
